long_biography.plain_text:
Komninos grew up around his father's coastal-trading business in Piraeus, then joined his older brother's ocean-going shipping company after maritime studies and work experience in London. In 1986 he struck out independently, establishing Target Group with refrigerated cargo ships before adding containerships and dry-bulk carriers. A four-ship Korean newbuilding order in 2000 accelerated the group's expansion.

Horizon Tankers added a parallel tanker operation while Target Marine continued in dry bulk. Across five decades, companies under his direction have managed about one hundred vessels, and he remains active in newbuilding programmes. Komninos also formed a charitable foundation focused on health, education and culture; his sustained collecting of philhellenic art has become a second public identity alongside shipping.
